document: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2022

clauses.title: Electronic Products Declaration and QR Code Provisions
clauses.text: For electronic products, mandatory declarations may additionally be provided by way of a QR code on the package, provided that MRP, net quantity, month/year of manufacture and consumer care details are physically declared on the package.
clauses.evidence_text: In case of electronic products, mandatory declarations may be made available through a QR Code, provided physical declarations for MRP, Net Qty, Date of Manufacture and Consumer Care are present.
